entertainment.name_local: % Arabica阿拉比卡咖啡(王府中環店)
entertainment.location_base: 3F, East Tower, Wangfu Zhonghuan, 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号王府中环东座3层301a号
entertainment.note_base: Iconic Japanese specialty coffee brand with minimalist design; great for a mid-shopping break and photos with branded cups.
entertainment.note_local: 极简风格日系网红咖啡，购物中途休息拍照佳选，品牌杯出片感强。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~40-70 CNY per person for a latte or seasonal special. Located in the upscale Wangfu Zhonghuan mall in the heart of Wangfujing. Same building as théATRE tea — choose one.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均40-70元，推荐拿铁或季节限定款。位于王府中环核心商场，与茶聚场同楼，二选一即可。

entertainment.location_base: L4, Unit 414, East Tower, Wangfu Zhonghuan, 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号王府中环东座L4层414
entertainment.note_base: Theatrical concept tea-house brand with dramatic interior design; one of Beijing's most photogenic afternoon tea spots.
entertainment.note_local: 具有戏剧感的网红茶饮空间，室内设计极具视觉冲击力，出片率极高。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~60-90 CNY per person for drinks and light snacks. Located in Wangfu Zhonghuan on upper floors. Recommended alternative to % Arabica in the same mall.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均60-90元含轻食，位于王府中环上层，与% Arabica同楼，可择一打卡。

entertainment.location_base: L4, Unit 430, Beijing APM Mall, 138 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街138号北京apmL4层430
entertainment.type_local: 书店 / 生活方式逛店
entertainment.note_base: Premium lifestyle bookstore known for curated art, design, and travel books alongside stylish stationery. The Beijing APM flagship is among the city's most photogenic bookstores.
entertainment.note_local: 高端生活方式书店，精选艺术/设计/旅行类书籍，环境优美，是北京最上镜的书店之一。
entertainment.notes_base: Free entry; budget 50-200 CNY if purchasing books or stationery gifts. Located in Beijing APM mall on Wangfujing Street — easy to slot in between shopping stops.
entertainment.notes_local: 免费入场；购书或文创周边预算50-200元。位于北京apm商场，购物途中顺路可逛。

entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街256号
entertainment.note_base: Wangfujing Pedestrian Street is beautifully illuminated in the evening and perfect for a relaxing post-dinner stroll and couple photos. In early April the area is lively with spring shoppers.
entertainment.note_local: 王府井步行街夜晚灯光璀璨，饭后漫步氛围极佳，适合拍情侣照。四月初春，人气旺盛。
entertainment.notes_base: Free. Best enjoyed after dinner ~19:30-21:00 when neon lights and store displays are at their brightest. Easy walk between mall exits.
entertainment.notes_local: 免费。晚饭后19:30-21:00最佳，霓虹灯与橱窗灯光最绚丽，各商场出口间步行可达。

entertainment.location_base: Unit 104, 1F, 157 Dongsi South Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区东四南大街157号1层104号
entertainment.note_base: One of Beijing's most celebrated craft beer bars, a short walk from Dongdan/Wangfujing. Excellent selection of house-brewed ales, IPAs, and seasonal taps in a relaxed atmosphere.
entertainment.note_local: 北京最知名的精酿啤酒吧之一，距东单/王府井步行可达，自酿麦酒、IPA及季节限定款丰富，氛围轻松惬意。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~80-150 CNY per person for 2-3 pints. Open until midnight. No reservation needed on weeknights. Located near Dengshikou Metro Station Exit A.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均80-150元可喝2-3杯，营业至午夜，工作日无需预订。灯市口地铁站A出口旁。
